field.label: Enable mihomo
field.help: Start the mihomo service at boot time. It is deliberately disabled by default: with TUN automatic route takeover enabled, starting an unconfigured proxy takes the whole network offline.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Verbosity of the mihomo log file. Use "error" or "silent" for long term operation to keep the log small.

field.label: Mode
field.help: rule: follow the routing rules (normal operation) global: send everything through the selected proxy direct: bypass every proxy

field.label: Allow LAN
field.help: Allow clients from the local network to use the SOCKS/HTTP proxy ports directly.

field.label: Bind Address
field.help: Address the RESTful controller listens on. Keep 127.0.0.1 so that only this firewall can reach it — this WebGUI talks to the controller over the loopback interface.

field.label: Secret
field.help: Shared secret for the controller API. Leave empty only if the controller is bound to the loopback address.

field.label: TUN Mode
field.help: Create a virtual network device so that traffic can be routed into mihomo without touching client configuration.

field.label: Device Name
field.help: Interface name of the TUN device. It must match the interface that the firewall rules refer to (default tun_mihomo).

field.label: Stack
field.help: gvisor is the most compatible option on FreeBSD; system may fail under some conditions; mixed combines both.

field.label: Automatic Route
field.help: Automatically insert routes for all traffic into the TUN device. This is what makes mihomo a transparent gateway — and what turns an unconfigured proxy into an outage.

field.label: Strict Route
field.help: Make sure the TUN device wins over other default routes while the service is running.

field.label: MTU
field.help: Maximum transmission unit of the TUN device.

field.label: DNS Module
field.help: Let mihomo answer DNS queries itself (needed for fake-ip mode and rule based resolution).

field.label: Listen Address
field.help: Loopback address and port mihomo listens on for DNS, e.g. 127.0.0.1:1053.

field.label: Enhanced Mode
field.help: fake-ip returns a synthetic address and resolves on connection; redir-host resolves up front and reports real addresses.

field.label: Subscription URL
field.help: HTTP(S) URL of your subscription. It is stored in the plugin environment file and used by the subscription updater.

field.label: Access Secret
field.help: Secret that the subscription updater writes into the generated configuration.

field.label: Restart After Update
field.help: Restart mihomo automatically once a subscription update finished successfully. Keep this off until you have verified the new nodes.
